description: Kept the mornings, and sent him to warm his hands.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Named the cold and the note as two different things, and went to Aldermanbury.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Said his hand was not needed, and refused to invent a cloak tonight.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Set tomorrow as the same note, and Saturday as not yet.
name: William Shakespeare
